final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy across pc1–pc31 and the recursive resolver on pc32. All PCs now use pc32 for DNS. Delegations include nameserver glue, and the requested MX and A records are in place.

I used pc6’s address for `www.example.com`, since the diagram did not specify one. The record does not start a web service.

[DNS-README.md](DNS-README.md) contains the configuration assumptions and example queries. All 40 startup scripts passed shell syntax checks, and all 31 authoritative zone files are present. I could not run BIND or an end-to-end lab test: BIND is unavailable in the workspace, and Docker access was denied.
